common.tagline: Tell Step Job your career once.

problems.unreachable: Could not reach Step Job. Nothing was changed — check your connection and try again.
problems.unknown: Something went wrong, and nothing was changed. Please try again.

sign.title: This is Step Job
sign.body: One profile of your career, and every document a job search in Japan asks for generated from it. Nothing is asked for twice.

rirekisho.title: 履歴書, on the top floor
rirekisho.body: A conventional 履歴書 as a PDF — A4 or B5, dates in 和暦 or 西暦, every line of it taken from your profile.

import.title: Bring what you already have
import.body: Upload a resume you have written before. What is read from it is shown to you field by field, and nothing reaches your profile until you say so.

profile.title: Your career, written once
profile.body: Work history, education, skills and certifications. This is the floor everything else is built on.

stories.title: The longer version
stories.body: The accounts of your work that a resume has no room for, kept for the moment an employer asks.

makers.title: The two of us, and makaka
makers.body: Josh and Mich have been building this since 2018, when it was an Android app. The cat has been supervising for about as long.

home.headline: Write your career once. Generate the documents from it.
home.lead: Step Job keeps one profile of your work history and produces the documents a job search in Japan asks for — starting with a 履歴書 that follows the convention, in 和暦 or 西暦, on A4 or B5.
home.worldHint: Point at a blue dot to look inside.

capture.title: Enter it once
capture.body: Your work history, education, skills and certifications live in one profile. No document asks you to type them again.

import.title: Or bring what you already have
import.body: Upload an existing resume and review what was read from it, field by field. Nothing reaches your profile until you approve it.

generate.title: Generate what you need
generate.body: Every document is assembled from the profile, so each line traces back to something you wrote.

profile.title: Career profile
profile.body: Your name, contact details, work history, education, skills and certifications.

import.title: Import a resume
import.body: Read an existing document and propose entries for your approval.

rirekisho.title: 履歴書
rirekisho.body: A conventional 履歴書 as a PDF, A4 or B5, dates in 和暦 or 西暦.

stories.title: Career stories
stories.body: The longer accounts of your work that a resume has no room for.

shokumu.title: Japanese career history (職務経歴書)
shokumu.body: Your work and achievements, drawn from the same career profile.

home.truthBody: A generated document can only say what your profile says. Where a suggestion comes from a model, you see it beside your own words and decide whether it is yours before it reaches a document.
home.since: Step Job began as an Android app in 2018. Same idea, same two people.

profile.title: Career profile
profile.subtitle: Enter your career once. Everything else is generated from it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.exportExplanation: Download everything you have entered: a data file you can keep or move elsewhere, and a readable document.
settings.deleteExplanation: This removes your career profile from Step Job.
settings.confirmHeading: Before you delete, please read this:
settings.confirmImmediate: Your residence status, nationality, visa type and visa expiry are erased immediately and cannot be recovered.
settings.confirmRecoverable: Everything else can be restored for 30 days.
settings.confirmPermanent: After 30 days it is permanently erased.
settings.deletedExplanation: It is no longer visible anywhere in Step Job.
settings.checkingRecovery: Checking this browser for a restore option…
settings.recoveryDeviceLimit: For privacy, this reminder stays in this browser and account. Use both before the date below.
settings.recoveryStorageUnavailable: We couldn't read a restore reminder for this account. If you deleted your profile, use the same browser and account and check that browser storage is available.
settings.recoveryStorageSave: Your profile was deleted, but this browser could not save the restore reminder. Restore now before leaving this page.
settings.recoveryStorageClear: Your profile was restored, but this browser could not clear the old reminder. A stale restore option may appear after reload.
settings.restoreFailed: We could not restore your profile. Your reminder is still here; try again.
settings.deleteFailed: We could not confirm profile deletion, and no restore reminder was saved. Check whether the profile is still active before trying again.

identity.title: About you
identity.furiganaHint: The phonetic reading of your Japanese name.
identity.addressHint: Used on a 履歴書, which conventionally asks for it.

japan.title: Working in Japan
japan.privacyNote: Every field here is optional and withheld from generated documents unless you include it. You can change that per field at any time.
japan.work_authorisation: I am authorised to work in Japan

experience.title: Work experience
experience.ongoingHint: Leave blank if this is your current role.
experience.sourceLanguageHint: The language you wrote this entry in. Other languages are generated from it.
experience.deleteWarning: Accomplishments are linked to this role and will lose their link.

stories.empty: You have not recorded any stories yet.
stories.explanation: Record what you achieved while you still remember it. These become reusable examples for resumes and interview answers.
stories.linkedRoleHint: Optional. Not every accomplishment belongs to a job you have recorded.
stories.title: Career stories

review.title: Review suggested entries
review.explanation: Entries brought in from elsewhere wait here. Nothing joins your profile until you accept it, and you can correct anything first.
review.possibleDuplicate: This may be the same role as {role}, which you already have.
review.conflict: Your document disagrees with itself here: {reason}. Please correct it before adding this.

import.title: Import your career
import.subtitle: Bring in what you have already written rather than typing it again.
import.pasteExplanation: Paste a resume, a profile from a job site, or anything you have written about your work. We read it and show you what we found — nothing joins your profile until you approve it.
import.pastePlaceholder: Paste anything about your career here.
import.nothingAddedYet: Nothing has been added to your profile yet. Review what we found to decide.

failures.unreadable_document: We could not read that document. It may be a scan with no text in it.
failures.unsupported_format: We cannot read that kind of file.
failures.no_career_information: We read it, but found no career information we could confirm.
failures.service_unavailable: The service that reads documents is unavailable right now. Your document was not used — please try again later.
failures.extraction_failed: Something went wrong reading that. Please try again.

import.uploadExplanation: PDF or Word documents. We read the text and do not keep the file — you already have the original.
import.japaneseNote: Japanese resumes are read as they are written. Era years such as 令和3年 are converted to calendar dates, and the original wording is shown beside them so you can check it. Nothing is translated.
import.stillRunning: This is taking a while. It is still running — come back and reload to see the result.

rirekisho.pageSubtitle: Built from your profile, in the form Japanese employers expect.
rirekisho.title: Generate your 履歴書
rirekisho.explanation: Every line comes from your profile. Nothing is invented to fill a blank — if something is missing, it stays blank and you can add it to your profile first.
rirekisho.photoNote: The photo box is left empty. We do not store your photograph; attach one yourself if the employer asks for it.
rirekisho.longDocument: This runs to {count} pages. A longer history produces more pages rather than dropping entries.
rirekisho.notStored: The document is not kept. Download it now, or generate it again whenever you need it.
rirekisho.snapshot: We recorded what this was based on (ref {id}), so you can check later what you sent.
rirekisho.leftToYou: The reason for applying (志望の動機) and personal requests (本人希望記入欄) change with every employer, so they are left blank for you to write by hand or fill in before printing.
rirekisho.englishNote: Entries you wrote in English appear in English. They are never translated, because a translated job title or school name would say something you did not write. If you want Japanese, add a Japanese version in your profile.
rirekisho.privateNote: Nationality, residence status, visa and work authorisation appear only if you chose to include them in your profile. Anything you have kept private stays out.
rirekisho.nameRequired: Add your name to your profile before generating a 履歴書.

readiness.title: Before you generate
readiness.explanation: What your 履歴書 would be missing, checked against your profile as it is now.
readiness.ready: Everything a 履歴書 needs is in your profile.
readiness.blankExplanation: The document is still produced. Nothing is invented to fill a box, so these stay empty until you add them.
readiness.englishExplanation: They are printed exactly as you wrote them and are never translated. Add a Japanese version to your profile if you want Japanese on the page.
readiness.nothingRecorded: You have not recorded anything yet. Add your name to your profile, and this page will tell you what else your 履歴書 needs.
readiness.unchecked: We could not check what your 履歴書 is missing. You can still generate it.

resume.pageSubtitle: A US-style resume built from your career profile.
resume.title: Generate your English resume
resume.explanation: Experience appears newest first with Western dates. Approved English is reused; other text appears as recorded. Nothing is translated during generation.
resume.privacyNote: Your photograph, date of birth, address and Japan-specific personal details are excluded, even if you chose to include them in Japanese documents.
resume.preview: Open preview in a new tab
resume.notStored: The PDF is not kept. Download it now, or generate it again when needed.
resume.nameRequired: Add your name in Latin letters to your profile.
resume.experienceRequired: Add work experience to your profile.
resume.unchecked: We could not check your profile. You can still try generating your resume.
resume.needsEnglishTitle: These entries will appear as recorded
resume.needsEnglishNote: They have no approved English version. You can still generate; Japanese text stays Japanese.
resume.namesTitle: These names will appear in Japanese
resume.namesNote: Supply official English names in your profile if needed. Names are never guessed or translated automatically.
resume.staleNote: The source has changed since approval. Your approved words are kept and will still be used.
resume.ready: Your profile is ready to generate.
resume.missingOther: Check your profile for missing or invalid information before generating.

translations.title: Review your English
translations.explanation: Compare your Japanese with English you can edit and approve. A draft never joins your profile until you approve it.
translations.exactWords: Only the words in this box are saved, exactly as you approve them.
translations.staleNote: The source changed after this English was approved. The existing English is still used until you approve a replacement or remove it.
translations.draftOnly: This is a suggestion, not a saved English version. Compare it with the source before approving.
translations.alternativesHint: Choose the meaning of each ambiguous phrase. A choice updates the English when its wording can be located unambiguously; otherwise edit the English yourself.
translations.ownWording: I will use my own wording
translations.resolveAlternatives: Choose a meaning for every phrase, and make sure the chosen wording appears in the English box. Or choose to use your own wording.
translations.remove: Remove approval and use the source
translations.replaceDraft: Using a suggestion replaces the unsaved English in this card. Requesting a draft does not change your English. You can also write it yourself.
translations.unavailable: The translation service is unavailable. Try again shortly, or write the English yourself.
translations.unusable: The service returned an unusable draft. Your English was kept. You can write the English yourself.
translations.invalidSource: This source cannot be drafted. It may be empty or already in English. Refresh to check the latest profile.
translations.entryMissing: This entry is no longer available. This request did not save or remove English. Refresh to check your profile.
translations.invalidApproval: The English could not be saved. Enter nonblank English and check that this entry is still available.
translations.invalidName: The name could not be saved. Check the name and try again.
translations.sourceMissing: The source entry is no longer available. You can remove its old approval.
translations.saved: Your approved English was saved to your profile.
translations.removed: The approval was removed. This field will appear as recorded until you approve new English.
translations.nameSaved: The official English name was saved to your profile.
translations.noProfile: There is no profile to review yet. Record your career first.
translations.loadFailed: We could not load the current worklist. Any earlier confirmed saves or removals are already stored. Refresh again to check the latest profile.
translations.missingRequired: Your resume still needs profile information. You can review English here, then return to your profile to complete it.
translations.nothingMissing: No recorded resume fields are waiting for English.
translations.namesNote: Names are never drafted or guessed. Supply the name the organisation or certification uses, or leave it blank to keep the recorded name.
translations.discardSuggestion: Discard suggestion and use my wording
translations.nameUnsupported: This name cannot be edited here yet. It will remain as recorded; no change was saved.

shokumu.pageSubtitle: Your work and achievements, drawn from the same career profile.
shokumu.title: Generate your 職務経歴書
shokumu.explanation: Choose the order, dates and paper. These choices change presentation only; every recorded entry stays in the document.
shokumu.contentNote: No model writes this document. English entries stay in English. 自己PR is labelled and left blank for you. Japan-specific personal details are excluded.
shokumu.preview: Open preview in a new tab
shokumu.notStored: The PDF is not kept. Download it now, or generate it again when needed.
shokumu.nameRequired: Add your name in Latin letters to your profile. No document was generated.
shokumu.experienceRequired: Add work experience to your profile. No document was generated.
shokumu.missingOther: Check your profile for missing or invalid information. Nothing was generated.
shokumu.invalidChoice: Choose one of the listed options. No document was generated.
shokumu.noProfile: No profile is available. Record your career first; no document was generated.
